items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: I was in that group. Chris Cliff was on trumpet.

ctx.x: That's like $10 a week. That's right. And raise your family, bring up your family? That's right.

They used to pick another thing. They picked so many musicians, they had three bands. They had number one, number two, number three bands. They would say you would play the dancers. Like the school, that's some high school, you would go there and play the dancers. Number one band was a big band, or it was about 14 pieces of that. Number two band was a ten piece band. Number three was a seven piece band. I was in that group. Chris Cliff was on trumpet. I can't take the rest of the music. Well, it's just as well…

And I know you're tired. We should appreciate your help, though. So, let me get out a piece of paper for you to sign, if you don't mind. You know, it's easy. Give us the right case somebody wants to write up something in a magazine about you. You got the heavy rule.
